investment_policy_en:
Since 2007, ODDO BHF Polaris Balanced has offered a global and broadly diversified, balanced multi-asset investment solution. It is characterized by an equity allocation between 35% and 60% and a bond segment that invests mainly in investment grade bonds. The portfolio may invest in securities listed or traded on regulated markets, mainly in Europe, the US or Emerging Markets.

The investment objective is to generate attractive asset growth with reduced fluctuations in value through value-oriented investments, while taking into account environmental, social issues and corporate governance (ESG) criteria.
